data.name: BOMBACON!
data.detailed_description:
Pig Out: Defuse with Your Crew! 🐷💣

You know how bomb defusal games work: someone says "cut the red wire," someone cuts it, and everyone goes home safe. No such luxury here. Because your team is made up of three unfortunate little pigs — one mute, one blind, and one deaf!

To crack open these complex, modular, and cartoon-styled briefcases, you have only one choice: build a flawless communication chain. But beware: this barnyard is packed with high amounts of misunderstanding, unjust accusations, and frantically scribbled notes!

Meet Your Crew!

  • 🐷 Mute Pig (The Expert): The defusal manual is theirs alone. They know all the answers, but they can't utter a single word! They must quickly scan the manual, grab their pen and paper, and write or draw the solutions for the Deaf Pig. Their only hope is that their frantic handwriting actually makes sense under pressure!

  • 🐷 Blind Pig (The Defuser): The only one who can actually touch the bomb and cut the wires. But they can't see the world or read the screens. Thankfully, their hearing is perfectly fine! They rely entirely on the instructions coming through the radio to defuse the bomb with their hooves.

  • 🐷 Deaf Pig (The Translator): The ultimate bridge of the team. They can't hear a thing, but their eyes are sharp. They closely read the notes and sketches scribbled by the Mute Pig, decode what they mean, and shout the instructions out loud to guide the Blind Pig.

Build Your Own Language!

How you build your communication chain, how you draw your clues, and how you pass the info along is entirely up to you. The game doesn't impose a method. Building a functional communication and drawing system out of this absolute madness is your job!

Features

  • 3-Player Co-op — No more, no less. Exactly three pigs required in this barnyard.

  • Asymmetric Roles — Every player sees, hears, and can do something completely different.

  • Write, Draw & Decode — When words fail, the pen does the talking! Race against the clock while trying to decipher the Mute Pig's messy handwriting.

  • Modular Briefcase Puzzles — Each briefcase features different modules, different decryption panels, and different kinds of panic.

  • Role-Restricted Voice Chat — In-game voice chat is strictly limited by your role. Hearing and writing correctly has never been this stressful!

  • Level System — Defuse the bombs to unlock new levels. The difficulty comes along for the ride.

  • Free Mode — Design your own bomb/briefcase. Test how much you actually trust your friends.

Friendships are not guaranteed. Get ready for a mudbath!

data.short_description: A blind pig, a mute pig, and a deaf pig. A BOMB about to explode! BOMBACON! is a chaotic 3-player co-op bomb defusal game that tests your friendships in the most absurd way. Grab your radios, set up your communication chain, and open the briefcase before time runs out. Or you're all bacon!
